purpose: Teach: 群衆/語源/裏切っ/献血/くくっ/苑/龍/埋もれ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、革命時の群衆心理を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on crowd psychology during the revolution, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, pedagogical check-in. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Slight upward lilt at the end — opening space for her to respond. Teacher-to-student, but genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、漢字の語源を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the etymology of kanji characters.
lines.style: Clear and direct, no apology. Slight surprise underneath — she's correcting gently. Speaks with quiet confidence, eyes steady. Not defensive, just factual.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 同盟国に裏切った国家を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: I see. So you explored how allied nations betrayed each other — is that right?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slower pace, genuinely processing. Slight upward intonation on the question, genuinely checking her understanding. Warm but observant.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、災害時の献血運動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, my paper was on blood donation campaigns during disasters.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact correction, patient without condescension. Speaks with the quiet certainty of someone who knows her own work. Even tone, no edge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 紐をくくった結び目の文化史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ah — the cultural history of knots and how they're tied. That was your topic?
lines.style: Genuinely intrigued, moving through ideas. Reflective tone, slightly slower. The cadence of someone piecing something together. Warm uncertainty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、宮内苑の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, I wrote about the history of the imperial gardens.
lines.style: Calm, patient. Third correction delivered without frustration. Voice stays level and clear. She's settling into her role as the one clarifying.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 龍の伝承を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Right — and dragon mythology in classical texts, correct?
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly in energy. Warmer now, more engaged. Still a question, but with more light in the voice. Testing whether they're finally on the same page.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、書庫に埋もれた古文書を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined ancient manuscripts that had been buried in the archives for centuries.
lines.style: Calm finality. Speaks with modest precision. The last piece clicking into place. Slight warmth now — they're finally aligned. A small relief in the trailing consonants.
